tagline: Enterprise Information Management, powered by our people.
overview:
EIM enables organizations to manage structured and unstructured data across business operations, extract valuable business insights and secure that information while meeting compliance requirements, all on a single platform at enterprise level.

The goal of information management solutions is to improve efficiency, promote transparency and enable business insights by leveraging software solutions and technologies that are designed to help organizations extract value from their information.

portfolios.name: Retail Banking
portfolios.description: Retail Banking delivers financial services directly to individual customers, helping them manage personal finances, access credit, and achieve financial security. It includes everyday products such as savings and checking accounts, personal loans, mortgages, credit cards, and digital banking platforms.

portfolios.name: Business Banking
portfolios.description: Business Banking provides tailored financial services and solutions to small, medium, and large enterprises, enabling them to manage operations, access credit, and grow sustainably. It encompasses products such as business accounts, loans, treasury services, and digital platforms designed to support entrepreneurs and corporations alike.

portfolios.name: Risk & Compliance
portfolios.description: Risk & Compliance ensures that financial services and data solutions are delivered securely, ethically, and in alignment with regulatory standards. It involves identifying, assessing, and mitigating risks across business banking, retail banking, and incentive programs, while maintaining trust and transparency with customers and regulators.

portfolios.name: Finance & Treasury
portfolios.description: Finance & Treasury is responsible for managing the organization’s financial resources, liquidity, and capital structure to ensure stability, growth, and compliance. It oversees budgeting, forecasting, investment strategies, and cash flow management, while safeguarding against financial risks.

responsibilities: Design and operate the enterprise data warehouse and its ingestion pipelines.
